Contract diff: git diff --name-only <pre-148H>..HEAD -- docs/contracts/ empty (PBPC-001 remains v1.2, PBPA-001 remains v1.0, both unamended). Verdict: CHAPTER 148 CERTIFIED WITH RETAINED NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS.
